cohort: Children born in Sweden between 1997 and 2014 who were diagnosed with a femur or humerus shaft fracture before age 1 year.
finding: Birth-related femur and humerus shaft fractures were associated with specific perinatal factors, while later fractures were primarily caused by fall accidents and, notably, by maltreatment in infants under 6 months.
mod_finding: Birth-related femur shaft fracture was associated with cesarean delivery, and birth-related humerus shaft fracture was associated with dystocic labor and vacuum-assisted delivery.
